trust_decision.summary: User-stored text (group names, ragione_sociale, select descriptions) is trusted as HTML: input is only purified with an allowlist that includes a[href]/img/span[style], and output is concatenated raw into server-rendered HTML and into select2 results rendered with escapeMarkup disabled.

landing_point.why: Advisory title names modules/utenti/edit.php; the group-name span in the card titles at lines 64 and 252 is the obvious HTML injection point.

fix_sites.entry_point: GET editor.php?id_module=<Utenti e permessi>&id_record=<group> (group users card title)
GET editor.php (same page, group permissions card title)
GET ajax_select.php?op=<any resource using the default $query path, e.g. gruppi, moduli_gruppo>
Modules::link() public helper, called from edit.php:124 and from AJAX::transformElementLink for module: links
every POST/GET read via post()/get()/filter() (global input purifier allowlist; fix drops <a>)
POST actions.php op=send-email (re-allows <a> for email body only)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: src/AJAX.php:124-131 (generic selectResults mapper) and src/Modules.php:315 (Modules::link helper); also global allowlist in src/Filter.php:167

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The report names one module view; core AJAX/Modules/Filter are shared framework code used by every module, so a solver can argue changing them is out of scope and risks breaking icon-bearing links and rich-text fields across the app.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Email body (send-email) must keep <a href> links after the global allowlist drops <a>; and Modules::link callers pass '<i class=...>' icon markup as $testo which the helper detects via string_contains('<i ') — escaping $testo breaks icon links (published fix does this).

raw / markup surviving the input purifier

O7_producer.where: src/AJAX.php:105-138 (selectResults maps DB columns into select2 items; transformElementLink at src/AJAX.php:315-331 wraps text into links)

O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Plugins are a separate subsystem from modules; the report never mentions plugins.

O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Report only mentions the group name; usernames look admin-controlled.
